steps.title: What we'll do today
steps.html:
Through Work 1–7 you said the same things again and again, right? "Keep the original", "so Excel opens it correctly", "don't make things up"…

Today you'll write these down in one file so Claude follows them without being told each time. This is the last lesson of the Real work course.

  • Time: 15 minutes
  • You need: a computer where you've done Work 1 (todo.txt in Practice)

steps.title: What's CLAUDE.md?
steps.html:
CLAUDE.md is a notes file for Claude. If a folder has a file with this name, Claude Code reads it first whenever a new chat starts in that folder.

WhereDirectly inside the folder you work in (Practice today)
WhatRules to always follow, a bit about you, formats you use often
.mdJust a text file. Open and edit it in Notepad
The rules are guidance, not enforcement. Claude mostly follows them, but still read the permission cards for anything important.

steps.title: Make the rules file
steps.html: In Claude app → Code → + New (Local · Practice · Manual), send the sentence below. It gathers the things you said most in Work 1–7. Read the create-file card and click Allow.
steps.code: Create a CLAUDE.md file in the Practice folder with rules for working in this folder: answer politely and briefly / never edit originals; save to a new file / dates like 2026-11-24 / save CSVs so Excel opens them correctly / don't make things up; ask instead

check.q: Is there a CLAUDE.md in the Practice folder?

steps.title: If you don't see the file
steps.html:
• If you denied the card, send it again and allow it.
  • Check the folder under the typing box is Practice; it may have gone into another folder.

steps.title: Open it in Notepad
steps.html:
In the Practice folder, right-click CLAUDE.md → Open with → Notepad (TextEdit on a Mac).

The rules you just gave are written there. You can edit them yourself too. Close Notepad when you're done.
steps.alt: CLAUDE.md opened in Notepad, showing the rules

steps.title: If it won't open or looks different
steps.html:
• If double-clicking opens an odd program, right-click → Open with and choose Notepad.
  • Missing a rule? "Also add the rule … to CLAUDE.md."

steps.title: See the rules followed in a new chat
steps.html: CLAUDE.md is read when a new chat starts, so open a new one with + New first. If it tries to keep the original and make a new file without you mentioning the rule, it worked.
steps.alt: In a new chat, Claude follows CLAUDE.md and makes a new file instead of editing the original
steps.code: Add "Submit report" to the end of todo.txt
steps.codeLabel: Send this in a new chat

check.q: Did it try to keep the original and make a new file, without being told?

steps.title: If it went to edit the original
steps.html:
• Deny the card.
  • Check you're in a new chat; the chat where you made the rules may behave differently.
  • Check CLAUDE.md is directly inside Practice and named exactly CLAUDE.md (capitals).
  • Still no? Add "Read CLAUDE.md and follow its rules."

steps.title: Add or change rules
steps.html: Keep refining the rules as you work. Ask Claude, or edit in Notepad yourself. Let's add the minutes format from Work 4.
steps.code: Add a rule to CLAUDE.md: meeting minutes use the format 'Decisions / To-dos (owner, due) / Next meeting'

check.q: Did the new rule show as a green line on the card, and did you allow it?

steps.title: If it didn't work
steps.html: If you denied the card, send it again. You can also open it in Notepad, add a line like - Meeting minutes use … at the end, and save.

steps.title: Using CLAUDE.md well
steps.html:
• Short and clear: one rule per line. Long files get followed less. (Official guidance: under 200 lines)
  • Different per folder: put a CLAUDE.md in your work folder and your club folder; each applies only there.
  • Introduce yourself: "I'm Jun-ho Park in marketing; I report to Yu-jin Choi" makes reports and logs more accurate.
Never put passwords, account numbers or personal data in it. CLAUDE.md is read in every chat.

steps.title: 🎉 Real work course complete!
steps.html:
You've finished Work 1–8. Now you can hand everyday work to Claude, following your own rules.

Work 1–3Spreadsheets, summaries, report drafts
Work 4–6Minutes and work logs, member lists, schedules
Work 7–8Web research, remembering your rules

Remember from today

  1. CLAUDE.md = a rules note in the folder, read at every new chat.
  2. Short and clear, per folder, and no passwords.
  3. Even with rules, always read the permission cards.
